entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Linda. How can I help you today?
Hello, Linda. I'm calling because I'd like to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently purchased.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number to pull up your account?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. It looks like it was delivered about two and a half weeks ago. That's well within our **90 days** return window, so it's **no problem** at all to get this processed for you.
Oh, that's fantastic. I was worried it might be an issue.
Not at all. I've just initiated the return for you and sent a prepaid **return label** to the email we have on file. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
That was incredibly fast. Thank you so much.

Of course! And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a 20% off coupon to your account for your next VeloFit purchase. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Wow, you didn't have to do that! That's very generous. No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day!
